units.source_text: （三）因此之故，相传本子亦有大同小异者三种：

en.t: For this reason, the transmitted texts are said to fall into three types, with broad similarities and minor differences:

units.source_text: 一曰河内本，乃河内守源光行及其子源亲行所校订者，

en.t: The first is called the Kawachi text, edited by Kawachi no Kami Minamoto no Mitsuyuki and his son Minamoto no Chikayuki;

units.source_text: 流行于镰仓时代（一一九二—一三三三），

en.t: it circulated widely during the Kamakura period (1192-1333),

units.source_text: 入室町时代（一三三八—一五七三）而绝迹，至大正时代又发现。

en.t: but disappeared after the beginning of the Muromachi period (1338-1573), and was discovered again in the Taisho period.

units.source_text: 二曰青表纸本，因其书封面青色，故名，

en.t: The second is called the Aobyoshi text, so named because the book's cover was blue;

units.source_text: 乃藤原定家所校订者，流行于室町时代之后，直至今日。

en.t: it was edited by Fujiwara no Teika and has circulated from after the Muromachi period down to the present day.

units.source_text: 三曰别本，则又与上二者稍有异同。

en.t: The third is called the variant text, which again differs somewhat from the two mentioned above.

units.source_text: 今日一般所采用者，乃青表纸本。

en.t: The text generally used today is the Aobyoshi text.
